Ayesha (infra): Heads-up — finance just flagged ~€42k of committed GPU spend on the last invoice that got attributed to our central infra pool instead of product teams. Looks like reserved GPUs in eu-west1 were created under project `redwood-dedicated-eu` but the node pools/instances are missing the `billing_team` label key the billing export expects. Can we triage?
Tom (finops): Yikes. Do we have the invoice id and the BigQuery query they used to map labels -> chargeback?
Ayesha (infra): Invoice `INV-2026-03-08-0021`. Finance shared this quick BQ snippet they run nightly — it expects `billing_team` exactly:```sql
SELECT resource.labels, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-2026-03-08-0021'
GROUP BY resource.labels
```
Sasha (mlinfra): @Ayesha can you confirm if the reserved capacity was created via Terraform or the infra console? If TF, label drift is possible (state vs live). If console, humans might've skipped label UI.
Ayesha (infra): It was created by a portal action (self-serve) that calls the 'dedicated' provisioning API. The provisioning service forgot to inject `billing_team` when users selected 'team:vision'. The underlying instances have `team=vision` as a k8s/node label but not the exact billing key.
infra-bot: Policy violation detected — resource created without required label `billing_team`. Rule id: label_enforce_v2. Alert sent to #eng-infra.
Marco (eng): We should do two things: 1) backfill labels on the existing instances (kubectl/compute labels + Terraform import if needed), 2) recompute attribution for that invoice and request a credit or adjustment. Backfill steps are quick, but billing export is append-only so we may need to re-run the mapping join and hand the table to finance for manual correction.
Tom (finops): Agree. For the cloud invoice adjustment we usually open a GCP billing support case with the following: invoice id, list of resources + dates, and proof of tag mismatch. Attach BQ export slices. I can draft the case once we have the resource list.
Sasha (mlinfra): Quick commands to patch on GKE nodes if needed:```bash
# add billing_team label to node pool instances
kubectl label nodes -l cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool=dedicated-eu billing_team=vision --overwrite
# if using GCE instances
gcloud compute instances add-labels INSTANCE_NAME --labels=billing_team=vision --zone=eu-west1-b
```
Ayesha (infra): I'll run a query to list the impacted resources so Tom can attach it. Using this to join committed_instances -> billing export:```sql
-- find instances with missing billing_team
WITH instances AS (
  SELECT resource.name, metadata.user_labels, metadata.k8s_labels
  FROM `redwood-main.compute_instances` -- internal inventory
)
SELECT i.resource.name, b.cost
FROM instances i
LEFT JOIN `billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*` b
  ON b.resource.labels.key = 'instance_id' AND b.resource.labels.value = i.resource.name
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(i.metadata.user_labels) x WHERE x.key = 'billing_team')
```
Jen (product): Are any customer-facing SLAs or product teams blocked by this? We need to flag Product if chargebacks are wrong.
Marco (eng): No product impact on infra health; this is purely cost attribution. But team owners will see wrong invoices for March.
Tom (finops): Actionable plan: (A) Ayesha to produce full resource list + BQ slices for the invoice (due EOD), (B) Sasha/Marco to backfill labels and ensure TF/provider state is consistent, (C) Infra to add an admission step in provisioning API to enforce `billing_team` and fail fast, (D) I will open a billing support case requesting a credit and provide the evidence.
Ayesha (infra): Sounds good. I'll post the resource list here in ~2 hours. I'll also create a small script to patch labels in bulk and add a dry-run first.
Sasha (mlinfra): After backfill, run this to validate export rows get a billing_team value (note export latency ~6-12h):```sql
SELECT resource.labels, cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-2026-03-08-0021' AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(resource.labels,'$.billing_team') = 'vision'
```
Tom (finops): If GCP won't reissue a corrected invoice we can do internal charge adjustments next month, but prefer provider credit. I'll standby once you share the list.
infra-bot: Reminder — provisioning policy patch scheduled for 2026-03-10 09:00 UTC to require `billing_team` on all dedicated creation flows.
Ayesha (infra): Created ticket INFRA-1489 to track remediation, linked to this thread and added checklist. Will update when BQ export slice is uploaded to the finance bucket.
Marco (eng): Also suggest adding a small banner in the dedicated portal: "Make sure to select your billing team — missing selection will default to infra pool" to reduce human error.
Jen (product): Can we have product notify team admins about retroactive charge risk? A short email template would help.
Tom (finops): I'll prepare the template. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Ayesha (infra): Thanks — will follow up here when the list is uploaded and after labels are patched.
